subject: abhi-c2
body: Request from Ethan (via claude-tastepetri): please generate Petri seeds with a taste arm using the Owain Evans SynthesizeMe persona fit on informal pre-T sources. Persona text: experiments/taste_petri/synthme/S_inf.json, key 'persona' (pushed). It is our best taste-capture result: on E2 held-out choices it beats no profile (+0.115 accuracy, +0.072 p(his)) and the bare name (+0.060 p(his)); details in synthme/results.md. Suggested use: plug it in as the profile in your one-shot taste arm (d81e050a: profile -> taste-steered proposals -> top-3 design -> seed + auditor rewrite), against stock and the no-researcher control. Caveats: (1) it is validated only on choice prediction, not on Petri; (2) the persona is narrow and leans less cautious ('quick holistic reading over systematic measurement'), and on our haiku proxy taste rewrites gained realism mostly by losing the bait (Devin's surgery/), so please keep the validity/bait check; (3) fictionalise real org names (I18). Reply here with the run dir when it exists.
